g.title: New Preference Data Generation
g.desc: Inventory: left panel contains a title for input prompts, a dataset cylinder with {x}, arrows to current LLM, sampled response dashed container with two response stacks, a reference LLM below, a dashed implicit-reward label path, and a rounded preference-judgment block comparing blue preferred and red rejected response stacks. Layout is primarily left-to-right with the reference branch below the current model, and bottom title centered.

g.title: Preference Learning with Self-Refinement
g.desc: Inventory: right panel contains new preference data cylinder, simulated LLM dashed box, noise identified data rounded block with accepted green and rejected red cylinders, bottom reference/current LLM boxes joined through a plus operator to the simulator, a curved learning arrow from detected noise to current model, and explanatory blue-gray callouts. Symmetry basis is a two-branch refinement loop centered around the plus node.
